known_limitations: Decision-STATE correlation only: the gate measures whether the anchors' position series are reproducible by dead ancestry families; it does NOT score any outcome. Survivability at D2 (A4-P2 ELIGIBLE) is a novelty verdict, not an expectancy claim; all downstream gates (S freeze, I, E under the heavy lock) still apply.

Parameters were frozen at declared neutral/median defaults (documented per-parameter in measure_novelty.py), not tuned; the A4-P2 ELIGIBLE margin (+0.090) is parameter-set-specific by construction of the freeze law (no post-hoc parameter search was run, per P-12/P-2).

The generic_dow_tue mapping on a weekly grid is the calendar clock's only admissible form: fixed side +1 on canonical post-Friday-release Monday sessions, -1 on holiday-shifted sessions; its near-degeneracy is inherent to the weekly representation and it measured MEASURED (non-zero variance) with negligible pooled rho everywhere (max 0.037).

Price-side warmup chains extend to the full measured substrate from 2016 while the MEASURED set is only the P2 counted window; the A4 price-only shadows' displacement-percentile coordinate needs ~4y of weekly history, so their per-pair observation counts start later inside the counted window (pairwise-complete pooling; exact n per shadow/pair recorded in the panel).

Pairs sharing a CoT market (001602 x DBA/WEAT, 002602 x CORN/DBA, 005602 x DBA/SOYB, 088691 x GLD/IAU) share the same CoT-side anchor geometry; pooling across the 11 declared bookable pairs follows the dispatch formula and the D1 bookable-set declaration.
